verdict.rationale: Rootly documents its own mobile app for iOS and Android aimed at on-call. On the phone it provides an Incident Summary card, a conversational Rootly AI agent, and mobile shift swaps and overrides. However, no evidence explicitly shows acknowledging, escalating, or resolving pages from the mobile app; the acknowledge/escalate/resolve claim applies to Microsoft Teams, not the phone app. missing for 10: documented mobile acknowledge/escalate/resolve actions, mobile push paging details, independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am

citations.quote: Rootly mobile app for iOS and Android on-ca
On any incident you have access to, the mobile app gives you an Incident Summary card and the conversational Rootly AI agent.
